verdict.rationale: Expensify documents a first-party Integration Server API, with credential and OAuth2 access, for downloading report data, provisioning accounts "and much more." Nothing shows it reaches parity with the UI, and many UI capabilities (travel, invoicing, cards, workspace rules) have no evidenced API coverage. The natural-language Ask Expensify features are a different interface, not the API, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint inventory, evidence of UI-to-API parity across features (expenses, approvals, workspaces, cards, travel, invoices), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
